steps.title: Create a demo order
steps.description: Start with the high-value headphones so you can see AgentX hand off a refund safely.

steps.title: Place the order
steps.description: This creates the verified customer, order and shipment used by AgentX.

steps.title: Open AgentX
steps.description: Support opens over the store, so the customer never leaves the shopping experience.

steps.title: Try a high-value refund
steps.description: AgentX collects the request, then seller policy decides whether AI can act automatically.

steps.title: Complete the refund request
steps.description: Choose the delivery state, reason and evidence. AgentX submits only the structured request you confirm.

steps.title: Seller control stays in the loop
steps.description: Requests above the automatic refund limit stop here for a human decision.
